caption: System Notification > Email > Notifications.

eyebrow: Two ways a notification can fire

steps.label: Record condition
steps.sub: insert, update, or a specific field change — e.g. Incident State changes to Resolved

steps.label: Named event
steps.sub: a script queues an event with gs.eventQueue(); the notification listens for that event name

steps.label: A record field
steps.sub: Caller, Assigned to, Opened by — dynamic, computed per record

steps.label: A group
steps.sub: every active member with an eligible email address

steps.label: A specific user
steps.sub: a fixed recipient regardless of which record fired it

steps.label: An Email field
steps.sub: a watch-list or CC-style address stored on the record
